status_contract.proven: Implemented and directly passed on this frozen artifact.
status_contract.implemented_unverified: Inspectable implementation exists, but this baseline did not run enough proof to promote it.
status_contract.partial: A reusable part exists, but the requirement is not complete on the target Pursuit path.
status_contract.violated: The frozen artifact directly contradicts the requirement.
